# OceanAstra

> OceanAstra is a technology company headquartered in Dubai. We believe technology knows no borders — we bring the world's most advanced productivity to the Middle East, so that every company here has a wider set of choices.

OceanAstra Technologies L.L.C is a technology company registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, holding commercial licence 1646635 issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism, Government of Dubai. It serves enterprise clients across the UAE, the wider GCC and Greater China.

## Lines of business

### AI Workplace

Lark as the company's single workplace — chat, email, documents, approvals and calendar in one platform, with the AI inside it actually put to work. Supplied and supported from Dubai.

- Lark's own AI actually put to work — meeting notes, an AI teammate that knows your documents and approvals, automation in Base, and real-time translation inside chat and documents
- Lark licences supplied under a signed reseller agreement — quoted and invoiced in AED by a UAE company, through the purchase-order process your finance team already uses
- Tenant setup, migration from the mail and file tools you run today, organisation structure, approval flows and integration with your existing systems

### Industry Management Solutions

A new way to manage the operations of a specific industry — through AI teammates who hold defined roles, or AI assistance layered onto existing work — and the systems a business is required to run, UAE e-invoicing first among them.

- CarSaas — an ERP for automotive trading in the Middle East, currently in development and launching soon
- Invobay — UAE e-invoicing for businesses in the Emirates (built in-house at invobay.com, in development and launching soon): choose a service provider accredited by the Ministry of Finance, get onboarded on EmaraTax, and issue invoices your provider accepts
- AI capability added to the systems an industry already runs, without replacing them

### Integration Partnerships

Bringing proven technology from around the world into the Middle East: selection, integration, localised delivery and long-term support.

- Amap — mapping and location services for logistics and field operations
- Further platforms assessed case by case; we bring in only what we are prepared to stand behind
- From requirement assessment through tenant setup, migration, training and support
